verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports agent/cron-driven task execution (docs-16) and MCP endpoints for agents to claim and act on tasks (docs-3, docs-19), suggesting some autonomous background operation. However, agents must run in a local checkout on the user's machine (docs-3) and a human must approve every contract before any change happens (docs-7), so it's not a fully autonomous background automation but a human-gated, locally-run agent workflow.
